\texttt{$<$span style="font-size:1.05em; font-style:italic; color:\#7A7A7A;"$>$}Mathematician Â· AI Tinkerer\texttt{$<$/span$>$}

I am an AI Scientist at \href{https://i14.ai}{i14} in Melbourne.

From March 2022 - February 2026 I was an Assistant Professor at the Yau Mathematical Sciences Center (YMSC), at Tsinghua University in Beijing.

Prior to this, I was a postdoc at Texas A\&M University working with \href{https://www.math.tamu.edu/directory/formalpg.php?user=guoliangyu}{Guoliang Yu}. I received my Ph.D. in December 2018 from the University of Adelaide under the direction of \href{http://www.maths.adelaide.edu.au/mathai.varghese/}{Mathai Varghese} and \href{https://math.ecnu.edu.cn/~wanghang/intro_c.html?language=2&id=204}{Hang Wang}.

I am interested in index theory, K-theory, and their connections to geometry, topology, and group theory.
